asA: operator running `rcf build finalise` from a dispatched worker that may not spawn the agent CLI
iWant: a `--mode deterministic` option on `rcf verify run` and `rcf build finalise` that runs the gate in-process with a per-AC skip ledger, and a partial-report fallback that names the mode and the reason when verify exits without writing a report
soThat: the finalise gate always surfaces a readable report, deterministic runs never silently promote to verified (ADR-4112), and the parent-session `agentScreenshotCritique` mode is unchanged for operators who can spawn the agent CLI
title: US-16503: a dispatched worker can run the finalise gate without spawning the agent CLI

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic produces a BLOCKED report with runStats.mode='deterministic' and a per-AC critique-only blockedAcs ledger when every AC in the chain requires critique.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a scaffolded RCF chain whose user stories carry acceptance criteria but no per-AC deterministic probe shape
acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf verify run --repo <chain> --profile ci --url http://localhost:3000 --out <path> --mode deterministic --provision-mode skip is invoked
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 5 (BLOCKED trips the default severity gate), the written report has verdict 'BLOCKED', run.runStats.mode='deterministic', run.runStats.counts.total matches the number of testable ACs with counts.verified=0 and counts.skipped=counts.total, and every entry in blockedAcs carries reason matching /critique-only/ and mode='deterministic'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an FBS at status 'complete' and a verify report whose run.runStats.mode='deterministic' and counts.skipped>0
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 4, the FBS stays at 'complete', and stderr matches /deterministic mode verified \d+ of \d+ ACs/ and /ADR-4112/
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-27 (stage-keeper ruling RC-19, round A ruling 5: retired and succeeded, never reworded): the light Finalise reads no report and never writes verified, so this 0.36.x report-based Finalise behaviour retires; finalise --url and --mode exit 2 with the no-verify-report line, spawn nothing and write nothing (AC-20003-1), so no deterministic-mode report refuses with exit 4.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an FBS at status 'complete' and a spawnVerify seam that returns exit code 1 WITHOUT writing to --out
acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf build finalise <fbsId> --url ... --mode deterministic is invoked
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is non-zero, the --out file is readable, run.runStats.mode='deterministic', run.runStats.status='aborted', run.runStats.exitCode=1, launchFailure.status='aborted', and the FBS stays at 'complete'
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-27 (stage-keeper ruling RC-19, round A ruling 5: retired and succeeded, never reworded): the light Finalise reads no report and never writes verified, so this 0.36.x report-based Finalise behaviour retires; finalise --url and --mode exit 2, spawn nothing and write nothing (AC-20003-1), so no verify launch aborts and no --out file is written.

acceptanceCriteria.when: rcf verify run --mode foo or rcf build finalise <fbsId> --url ... --mode foo is invoked
acceptanceCriteria.then: the exit code is 2 and stderr matches /--mode must be one of/
acceptanceCriteria.supersessionNote: Retired 2026-10-27 (stage-keeper ruling RC-19, round A ruling 5: retired and succeeded, never reworded): the light Finalise reads no report and never writes verified, so this 0.36.x report-based Finalise behaviour retires; finalise --url and --mode exit 2 with the no-verify-report line (AC-20003-1), not /--mode must be one of/; the rcf verify run --mode foo half stays in force under AC-20103-1 (the ad hoc probe keeps its 0.36.x output and exit codes).
